# ClientExplain AI

> Legal process project workspace. Foundation release.

Available: create, view, edit and delete legal process projects; edit a profile; upload private PDF, DOCX and TXT documents for asynchronous parsing; retry failed parsing; inspect document status and page count; edit, save and reopen process workflows; and download a PDF workflow report or locally generated PNG diagram from saved stage and connection data.

OpenAI and local Ollama analysis adapters are implemented. Analysis is blocked until an available provider is configured; real Ollama inference and hosted Supabase Auth/Storage acceptance are not verified. No legal output is guaranteed accurate.

Planned or incomplete: stage-specific illustrations, a substantive lawyer-review history, and version-history UI. The workflow review-status field alone does not demonstrate professional approval. PDF export currently supports printable Latin-1 text.

All AI-generated legal explanations require professional review and are not verified legal advice. Use non-confidential test information in this evaluation release.
